| `bsp-skills` | 8 | Host-side BSP development"},{"id":"p9s3","text":": cross-compilation, repo sync, kernel/DTB/driver builds, deb packaging, bootloader, rootfs customiz"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"ation |
| `oe-skills-x5` | 22 | X5 OE Mapper quantization (PTQ/QAT), compilation, runtime inference,"},{"id":"p9s5","text":" performance and accuracy diagnostics |
| `oe-skills-s` | 20 | S-series HBDK compilation, UCP infere"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"nce, Perfetto trace analysis, plugin chain debugging, precision tuning |

The agent"},{"id":"p32s2","text":" can read instructions and scripts, but skills that depend on workspace state (environment detection"},{"id":"p32s3","text":", package installation) will report the missing layout and guide the user through `rdk_oe_setup`.
